risks.risk: Internal components may not match the advertised specs (e.g., RAM, storage, or actual CPU model)
risks.proof: Photo of the system information screen (e.g., BIOS or Windows System Properties) showing the exact CPU model, RAM amount, and storage type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if the internal specs are unknown or potentially lower than advertised, which could reduce value.

risks.risk: The unit may not power on or may have hardware faults (e.g., dead SSD, faulty RAM)
risks.proof: Video clip showing the unit powering on, booting into the OS, and running a basic system check (e.g., CPU and RAM test).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The unit may have hidden physical damage or wear not visible in photos (e.g., cracked casing, damaged ports)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all ports, the back panel, and the interior (if opened) to check for damage or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as is, with potential for lower value if damage is found.

proof_requests: Video clip showing the unit powering on and booting into the OS.
Photo of the system information screen showing exact CPU model, RAM, and storage.
Close-up photos of all ports and the back panel.
response.reason: The model and processor are visually confirmed, but critical internal specs and functionality are unverified. Without proof of working condition and exact internal components, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risks of non-functionality or mismatched specs require further evidence before pricing.
